cases.name: Jennifer Brown
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a 1997 graduate of Absegami High School and also Atlantic County Vo-Tech where she studied culinary arts. She continued her studies of cooking at Atlantic Cape Community College in Mays Landing. Jen had worked as a Senior Representative of Inside Sales at Wesco Distribution in Norristown, PA for the past 5 years. In her free time, she enjoyed fishing, going to the beach, traveling, football and cooking. She especially enjoyed the time she was able to spend with her sons and loved family gatherings."
cases.narrative: On 1/18/2023, her body was found partially buried in a field behind a warehouse on North 5th Avenue near Royersford, PA. She had been asphyxiated and had three broken ribs.
